llm.summary: This skill is openly designed for stealth browser automation that bypasses anti-bot defenses and can reuse authenticated cookies, which requires careful review before installation.

dimensions.detail: Cookie import, arbitrary page JavaScript evaluation, residential proxy routing, GeoIP masking, and public-site automation are high-impact capabilities with limited user-facing warnings or consent/compliance guardrails.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts disclose a local Node browser server on port 9377 and an executable startup script that launches it with nohup/disown, but the skill metadata only declares node and does not fully scope the background process, hardcoded paths, or local binary authority.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Agent instructions broadly prefer camofox tools for external public websites, bot-hardened services, scraping, search, form filling, cookie-authenticated sessions, and retrying when CAPTCHA or blocking appears, without limiting use to authorized targets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The server auto-starts with the gateway, the startup script backgrounds the process, browser profiles persist under ~/.camofox/profiles, and cookie import can enable authenticated sessions when CAMOFOX_API_KEY is configured.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is anti-detection browsing that bypasses Cloudflare, CAPTCHAs, WAFs, and bot detection on public sites, including scraping behind login walls and use with residential proxies.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you have explicit authorization for the sites and accounts involved. Treat imported cookie files as live session credentials, restrict the domains and tasks used with this skill, avoid unauthorized scraping or bypassing access controls, and review the auto-starting local server and persistent profile storage before enabling it.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: A local browser server and Camoufox binary are coherent with the browser automation purpose, but the artifacts support the concern that process startup and executable authority are under-declared in metadata.
[SQP-2] expected: The artifacts confirm cookie import and authenticated browsing are advertised features; they are sensitive session-credential capabilities and the documentation lacks clear consent, secure handling, and account-impact warnings.
[SQP-2] expected: The artifacts confirm the skill promotes bypassing anti-bot protections for scraping and public websites; this matches the stated purpose but is under-scoped because no authorized-use, rate-limit, ToS, or compliance boundaries are provided.
[SSD-2] expected: The README and SKILL.md repeatedly market undetectable automation, WAF/CAPTCHA bypass, fingerprint spoofing, and residential proxy disguise, making defense evasion a core capability rather than incidental behavior.
[SSD-4] expected: The instruction to prefer stealth browsing for external public websites and retry blocked/CAPTCHA pages supports a Review verdict, but the artifacts do not show exfiltration, destruction, or deception sufficient for malicious classification.
